title: Closing: he will play until he drops
summary: Albertson notes they could talk about influences for another hour; Cheatham says he will keep playing as long as his heart and lungs allow, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: In other words if I were to ask you who influenced you we'd have another hour.
We would have more than an hour. Cause
I left out a lot of guys, you know.
I've omitted a lot of guys. Because it's as I say, I'm going to play until I drop. I mean if I have a heart attack then I'll stop cause I think that's the time to stop.
As long as my heart's good and my teeth, my lungs are good, I'm going to continue to play. Because I still like it.
